info.name: 00 - CURT Master Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive Master Postman collection for Cairo University Racing Team (CURT) Formula Student / FSAE® Team Project Management System (Season 26-27).

Flow Order:
1. 00 - System Health Check
2. 01 - Authentication Layer (Level 2)
3. 02 - Project Management & Membership RBAC (Level 2 & 3)
4. 03 - Task Management & Level 3 RBAC (Assignment Integrity, Dynamic Query Engine, Member Status Updates)
